lines: Oh wow, we actually made it. I could kiss this floor.
Okay, I'm giddy. Somebody pinch me before I start dancing.
I'm so happy I could cry, and I'm not even embarrassed.
Look at us, alive and everything. Who knew we had it in us?
Nobody tell the others I just did a little happy wiggle.
Did we really get out? Pinch me, my arm's gone numb.
Ha, I'm laughing too loud, but I honestly don't care right now.
We did it, we did it, we did it. I'm going to be insufferable.
I'm telling everyone I was the brave one. Nobody can prove otherwise.
My legs have quit. Carry me, or at least give me a minute.
I'm so tired I could sleep standing up. I'm not joking.
Give me five minutes on this bench before I fall over.
My shoulder's wrecked from that crawl. Don't bump it, please.
I need water, a nap, and maybe a sandwich. In that order.
Sitting down now. If I get up again, somebody bribe me.
Ugh, my feet hurt so bad. Whose idea were these shoes?
I'm wiped out. Let me lean on this wall for a bit.
My eyes are gritty and my brain's mush. Be nice to me.
Nice job not screaming back there, champ.
Did you really trip over nothing? Classic you.
Hey, the one who said this would be easy, come sit down.
Somebody owes me a cold can for carrying the flashlight.
You jumped at your own shadow back there. Don't even deny it.
Look who's talking, the one who hid in that broom closet.
Nobody's allowed to call me slow ever again, deal?
Your face was so pale back there, I thought you'd faint.
Okay, who let one rip? Own it, it's been ten minutes.
You sang the whole way up the stairs. Terrible, but brave.
Ten minutes of rest first, then we find the next door. Promise?
Once I can breathe again, we check the lift. Then we go home!
Next stop, the supply cabinet. I want my snack back.
Water first, then food, then we count our ammo like pros.
Who's got the spare battery? My flashlight's whining again.
Okay, my whole plan: nap, snack, then hunt down the others.
You take the front, I'll carry the heavy bag, deal?
After this, nobody goes back in the vents. Agreed?
When we move, stay close and point that flashlight at the floor, okay?
I'll lead, you watch the stairs, and nobody wanders off. Deal?
Oh thank goodness. I thought this whole building had us.
Fresh air, real air. Breathe it in, you earned it.
I can't believe the lights are on. Actual lights, look at that.
Thanks for waiting for me back there. Seriously, thank you.
I'm so glad to see your face. Even the grumpy one.
The door's shut and nothing's knocking. Best sound ever.
Okay, I can breathe again. Took me long enough, huh.
Nobody's bleeding that I can see. That's a win today.
Phew, I've been holding my breath since the stairs.
Good, it's quiet. I was really hoping for quiet.
You're the reason I kept going, so thanks for that.
Come sit by me. I'll share the last of my water.
Hey, you did good. Seriously, I'm proud of you.
I'd follow you into another mess, which says a lot about me.
Give me your hand. Let's sit together for a second.
We're a terrible team, but I'd pick you every single time.
I have one cold can left, and you are not getting it.
There's a granola bar in my pocket, and I'm in love with it.
Vending machine would've been so nice right about now.
I'm picturing a hot dog and I'm not even sorry about it.
Anyone seen the chocolate bar I hid? Not my fault if it's gone.
My flashlight's cranky again. Smack it, it works, mostly.
I was scared out of my mind, but we're still standing.
Honestly I almost quit back there. Don't tell anybody.
I'm not as brave as I sounded in the hall, just so you know.
My hands are shaking so bad I can barely hold this thing.
My heart's trying to leave my chest. Give me a second.
That was too close. Please never do that to me again.
Forty minutes of crawling, and my knees filed a complaint.
Worst field trip ever, and the tour guides were terrible.
I'm putting this on my resume: survived a building, no refunds.
Next time we pick a building with a better lift, okay?
Okay, that's enough adventure for one life, thanks.
We survived a building that wanted us gone. Good times.
Right, so after we rest, who's got a map?
First we rest, then we find the others. Then we argue about snacks.
Keep the door open a crack, I want to hear if anyone's coming.
Okay, somebody else go first next time. I'm tapped out.
